0.long_answer: Eosinophilic folliculitis is an inflammatory skin condition that manifests with itchy papules and pustules, particularly around hair follicles. It is frequently associated with immunocompromised states, especially in the context of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection. HIV is a disease that causes progressive immune system failure, making affected individuals more susceptible to various skin conditions, including eosinophilic folliculitis.
